vb_textbox.text: The brown, pink, yellow and purple gnomes lead you to a darker forest. I found that in general this led to a better result, and I very rarely collected zero mushrooms if I chose that colour gnome.The gnomes always appear in pairs, so whatever choice you have, go for the brown, pink, yellow or purple gnome.I don't think the hat height is relevant, or whether the gnome is on the left or right of the screen. Just choose whichever of those 4 colours is available, and this leads to a yellow basket and dark wood which always does well.
